comments:
See [MX3PRVV2]: 8/16.

The author refers abundantly to the views of his predecessors (including his own bla ma), whose names are provided in annotations in instance (ID:4574), notably 'Bre Shes rab 'bar (ID:3807), gTsang pa 'bre sgur (ID:3872), 'Dul 'dzin dkar mo (ID:3820) (see [4LWBNM7B]: 121-122).
[MX3PRVV2]: 8/16 also mentions critical responses to Ar Byang chub ye shes (ID:3816), rGya dmar ba (ID:3834), and gNyal zhig (ID:3887).

This could be the same work as the "'jam gsar gyi phar Tik" (ID:6542) listed by A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 529, No. 11511.
